run_generate_all_plots: run generate_all_plots to create factor distribution, spearman correlation, and model comparison plots from ImageNet annotations
build_ModelRobustnessPlot: build a ModelRobustnessPlot to visualize model robust and susceptible factors per metaclass as horizontal bar charts
build_CompareModelsPlot: build a CompareModelsPlot to generate grouped bar charts comparing misclassification shifts across multiple models
build_SingleModelOverall: build a SingleModelOverall plot to show robust and susceptible factors for a single model as a horizontal bar chart
run_model_comparison: run model_comparison to create a bar plot comparing error ratios or accuracy across models with optional significance testing
